entity_description_overrides.proj-b1f3b77a: Custom malloc implementation in C focusing on efficient memory reuse and fragmentation minimization with bucket-based allocation and free block tracking. Uses mmap for page management.
entity_description_overrides.proj-2a5cd1e4: Built STM32F429ZI embedded system acting as a UART command server using libgapcom (Protobuf over UART). Implemented a 4-level log subsystem and MPU6050 gyroscope driver over I2C with FIFO reads.
